basic_info.description: Step into this beautifully maintained, freshly painted, Spanish Mediterranean, 4BD/2BA home blending timeless San Francisco character with modern updates. Featuring hardwood floors, a bright and spacious layout, stunning period details, an updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and a large, shared backyard, this home offers comfort and style in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods. Bonus sunroom perfect a work day getaway! One car parking, storage, and deeded laundry area is included! Enjoy easy access to Golden Gate Park, top-rated schools, cafes, shops, and all that Clement Street has to offer. Bonus lower level space for office, gym, or guest use.
